dict.string: extensionItems.@count > 0 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, $item.attachments.@count > 0 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $attachment, ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR ($attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers.@count == 1 AND ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")).@count == $item.attachments.@count).@count == extensionItems.@count
